# Avdhesh Kumar — Full-Stack Developer & Software Engineer

> Official portfolio, production web projects, technical articles, and engineering services of Avdhesh Kumar.

## About
Avdhesh Kumar is a Full-Stack Web Developer, MCA scholar, and competitive chess enthusiast based in Gurugram, India. He builds responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.
